candidate.why_now: Your October 5 clinic discussion about metformin is 12 days away. The step counts being recorded cannot show whether your HbA1c has fallen, so a comparable result before that discussion would be useful.
candidate.what_changed: A September 22 note records the October 5 clinic discussion. The earlier analysis reports a June HbA1c of 6.3% from Lab A, but no later HbA1c result is on record. The newly added samples are step counts, not HbA1c measurements.
candidate.unknowns: It is not yet known whether HbA1c is lower. The June value appears in an analysis rather than a lab report available here. Even a lower repeat result would not establish that the low-carb diet caused the change.
candidate.next_step: If a result is available before October 5, compare a repeat HbA1c reported in %—ideally from Lab A—with the June lab report.
